---
title: "Negative Evidence"
---

Negative evidence records weaken, qualify, or falsify proposed Sacrificial Debt
claims. They are first-class evidence records, not footnotes to confirming
evidence.

Canonical file:
[`negative-evidence.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/negative-evidence.jsonl)

## Current Records

| Record | Proposition | Type | Strength | Review status | Packet |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sd-neg-000001` | `sd-prop-000001` | `contribution_reclassification` | `moderate` | `reviewed` | [sd-packet-000001](../packets/sd-packet-000001.qmd) |

## Current Meaning

The current negative-evidence record says Segall's statistical summary should
qualify later claims that German Jews failed to provide proportional military
contribution. It does not prove a Sacrificial Debt mechanism; it helps define
what later evidence would need to overcome.

## Review Boundary

Absence claims, chronology contradictions, rival explanations, and contribution
records must remain visible when they weaken a proposed mechanism claim. A
single reviewed negative-evidence record is not a project finding.
